human_operator.name: Image generation
human_operator.summary: A bundled 'imagegen' system skill (feature flag image_generation: stable, true) generates an image from a natural-language prompt in headless `codex exec` sessions; not exposed as a documented CLI flag or subcommand.
invocation: codex exec --sandbox workspace-write "Generate a <image> and save it as <file>.png ... Use your image generation skill if you have one."
limitations: No documented CLI flag or subcommand triggers it; invocation is a natural-language prompt the model routes to the bundled imagegen skill.
The underlying image model was not named in the transcript that produced the live-verified output; gpt-image-2 is inferred from release notes, not confirmed.
Not documented in `codex --help`, any subcommand `--help`, or official OpenAI Codex docs; evidence is a live local run plus release-note corroboration, not vendor documentation.

evidence.claim: Release notes reference an 'imagegen' bundled system skill updated for gpt-image-2 (rust-v0.124.0: 'Update imagegen system skill'; rust-v0.128.0: bundled OpenAI Docs skill updated for gpt-image-2), corroborating the feature-flagged image_generation capability observed live.
